text:
lia (product): FYI -> MerchantCo asked for a staged regional rollout plan for a new hallucination-mitigation guard in Private EU/NA. They want feature-flag driven slices, A/B for quality signal, and an emergency global fallback. Need something we can sign off on for their security review.

omar (infra): Key constraint: we can't add new routing infra for this quarter. Use tag-based routing in the proxy and percent buckets.

noah (sre): Proposed gates: quality_delta (human-eval) <= -1 point allowed for A/B, latency_p95 <= +25ms, runtime_error_rate <= +0.1%. Any gate fail triggers tenant-level rollback and a 30-min cooling window before re-attempt.

joanne (sales): MerchantCo wants admin controls: pause, abort, snapshot-export. Also wants per-region opt-in toggle so EU customers can stay on old model while NA moves.

pat (design): For admin UI: show per-region progress, last gate results, and a big "Abort and freeze" CTA. Provide CSV export link. Minimal wording.

lia (product): Rollout sequence suggestion: 1) shadow 48h (no billing) across both regions with tracing on, 2) NA 1% A/B (10k samples) for quality, 3) NA 10% canary, 4) EU 1% A/B, 5) EU 10% canary, 6) global ramp to 100%.

omar (infra): Implementation note: map feature_flag -> {region, slice_percent, billing_label}. Need cache flush plan when switching slices to avoid stale KV.

noah (sre): Auto-fallback modes: soft (route new requests to baseline but keep metrics) and hard (zone freeze + billing suspend). Hard fallback requires billing_label support. We'll default to soft then escalate.

lia (product): For product roadmap tradeoff: if we repeat per-tenant/regional requests, move to GA: implement tenant-aware routing, per-tenant quotas, and admin exports. Short term: manual ops template + runbook and a templated flag config.

joanne (sales): MerchantCo timeline: pilot start in 3 weeks. They accept manual runbook if we provide clear SLAs for rollback.

ci-bot: CI: feature-flag branch tests passed. Integration test warns on missing billing_label schema change.

lia (product): Action items: Omar -> flag templated JSON + cache-invalidation steps (48h). Noah -> runbook + alert queries (24h). Pat -> admin mockups (Tue). Joanne -> collect tenant IDs and compliance contacts (Fri). I'll collate and send to MerchantCo.

omar (infra): I'll draft the flag template: {"flag":"merchant-guard","regions":["NA","EU"],"slices":["shadow","1%","10%","100%"],"rollback_policy":"tenant-soft-then-hard"}.

noah (sre): I'll add a dashboard with per-region gate pass rates and a PagerDuty escalation for hard fallback.

lia (product): Thanks. We'll use this thread as the canonical coordination thread. Ping if blockers.
